name: Can privacy glass also help with UV protection and energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: Can privacy glass also help with UV protection and energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, many types of privacy glass and films offer additional benefits beyond just privacy, including UV protection and improved energy efficiency. Tinted privacy glass, especially those with low-emissivity (Low-E) coatings, can significantly reduce the amount of solar heat gain in your home during summer and prevent heat loss in winter. This helps maintain comfortable indoor temperatures and can lower energy bills. Furthermore, blocking UV rays helps protect furniture, flooring, and artwork from fading. It's a dual-purpose upgrade for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Many privacy glass types and films offer UV protection and boost energy efficiency by reducing solar heat gain and preventing heat loss. This helps lower energy bills and protects interiors from fading.
